card.name: Garden and paving surface words
card.fires_on: Words in gardening and landscaping text that point to hard surfaces or planting spots, such as paving, concrete, sidewalks, lawns, and the small linking words just before them.

modes.label: Paving and concrete
modes.description: The word paving or concrete, or the word just before it, in planting advice.
modes.example: on walls,<< between>> paving stones, in tubs or window

modes.label: Linking words before planting sites
modes.description: Short words like in, or, as before a planting area, lawn or driveway.
modes.example: Position your sprinklers so they don’t spray the sidewalks<< or>> driveway.

card.writes: It seems to push toward paving and retaining-type words, such as laying paving or holding in.
card.plain: It lights up in garden advice when the text is about paving, concrete, lawns and where plants go.
